title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: a package-less row at a holder's exact address answers one thing on every read and in every hydration state: declined for a sealed type, refused with two holders for an overlay type (ADR-0150 D4)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuXJAMZYj59b5X3KNNXXrJPe)_
Fixes #32568

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：不属于任何包的元数据行（package-less row）在某个持有包的精确地址（`?package=X`）上，按类型类别只给一种答案：可覆盖类型（email_template、dashboard、report）两个包同名时，草稿读、预览、分层读的 draft 层也一律 409 列出全部持有者；封闭类型（action、queue、hook 等）一律不采用这行，返回持有包自己的条目；读侧回填不再把这行塞进「第一个注册的包」的槽位。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 D4 与 ADR-0126 Regime C，按专题裁决 6817768147 落实：同一行数据在回填前后、草稿与正式读之间答案不同，属于「歧义被猜而不是被报告」（专题红线 2）。
- 风险与回滚：只改读路径，不改存储与 schema；第一方组合里没有两个包同名又带无包行的情况，计数为 0。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-registry-hydration.ts`（回填不再借第一个包的外壳）、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-reads.ts`（草稿与预览出口）、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-exact-qualifier.ts`（`declinedCopyReplaced`）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`，预期全部通过，其中 `[#32568]` 一组覆盖四种状态 × 两种注册顺序。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

A package-less row (a `sys_metadata` row bound to no package, or its copy in the registry's bare slot after a hydration) met at a holder's exact address now answers one thing on every read and in every hydration state, by type class (epic ruling 6817768147 on this card; ADR-0150 D4, ADR-0126 Regime C):

- **Overlay types** (`email_template`, `dashboard`, `report`): the row is a holder's customization. Two holders: `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `ambiguous-in-closure`, naming every holder, on the strict draft read, the preview and the layered `draft` layer as on the active read; the list scoped to a holder no longer previews such a draft. One holder: served, as before.
- **Sealed managed types** (artifact-backed, no overlay channel): the row is declined on every read at the address (active and its registry or service copy, strict draft, preview, layered read, layered `draft` layer). The address serves the holder's own shipped item, with one holder or two. The bare read of a two-holder name keeps its `409`.
- **The read-side hydrator** (`hydrateOverlayIntoRegistry`) never borrows an envelope through a package-less `lookupArtifactItem`: a package-less row wears its one holder's envelope, none with two holders, and a sealed type's declined row is not registered at all. A copy registered before the package arrived is healed by the one heal walk.
- **Upgrade guide**: semantic entry `package-less-row-exact-address-by-type-class` (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/`), registered by the changeset (`adr-0087: registered`), with its own `@objectstack/spec` patch changeset.

Branch note (Duplicate Fix Guard): this branch, `claude/project-thread-pjmygu`, continues `claude/project-thread-cyidlz@191cd2fab` (the previous holder's pushed WIP for this card) with `origin/main` merged in, never rebased; `claude/project-thread-cyidlz` is left as it was.

### FROM → TO

| # | Read (at `?package=X` unless named) | FROM | TO | Clause-② arm |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Overlay type, two holders, package-less draft: strict draft read, preview, layered `draft` layer | 200, the package-less draft at both holders | 409 `ambiguous-in-closure` naming both | narrowing |
| 2 | Overlay type, two holders: list scoped to a holder with drafts previewed | previews the package-less draft | the holder's own item | narrowing |
| 3 | Sealed type (`action`), package-less draft, one holder or two: strict draft read / preview / layered `draft` layer | 200 the draft / the draft / the draft | 404 no draft / the holder's own active item / `null` | narrowing |
| 4 | Sealed type, two holders, after the read-side hydrator (state 2) | 200, the stored body served as the first-registered holder's own | 200, each holder's own | narrowing |
| 5 | Sealed type, two holders, bare-slot copy stamped `''` or `sys_metadata` (state 3) | `action` 409 naming both; `queue` the copy | 200, each holder's own | none for `action` (a refusal the governing text denies, see below); narrowing for `queue` |
| 6 | Sealed type, two holders: layered read `?layers=true` | `action` 409 naming both; `queue` reported the row as each holder's `overlay` | `overlay: null`, the holder's own as `effective` | none for `action` (as row 5); narrowing for `queue` |
| 7 | Sealed type, one holder, after the read-side hydrator: exact read and bare read (the one-holder flip) | the stored body | the holder's own item, before and after | narrowing |
| 8 | `hook`, `job`, `queue`, `sharing_rule`, `assignment_rule`: environment item of a name two packages hold (location 2) | the environment's item at both holders | each holder's own | narrowing |
| 9 | `action`, one holder: the environment's item (the #32407 control) | the environment's item | the holder's own action | narrowing |
| 10 | Registry-direct read of a sealed `app` / `page` with a package-less stored row (what nav code reads) | the stored body under the package's envelope | the package's own definition | narrowing |
| 11 | The bare `/actions/:object/NAME` route (names no package) on an object neither of two holders binds, with the environment's package-less action bound there | the environment's item, found through the first holder's exact address (`?package=<first>` served it; the second holder's served its own) | no declaration (not a refusal) | narrowing |

Unchanged, pinned as CONTROLs: the bare read of a two-holder `action` (409, after the hydrator too); an overlay type's package-less row with one holder (served on every exit, and the hydrator lays it in under that holder's envelope); `email_template` with two holders (409 naming both, before and after the hydrator, and the first holder's slot keeps its own).

Why rows 5 and 6 carry no widening arm for `action`: the 409 there refused a row the governing text declines. ADR-0126 Regime C declines a sealed managed type's package-less row, and the ruling reads it at the exact address as "With the row declined, `?package=X` names its holder explicitly and serves X's own shipped item, exactly as it would with no row stored." No export is added: `declinesPackageLessRowAt`, `isPackageLessRow` and `declinedCopyReplaced` are module-internal (not in `src/index.ts`).

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`: a new `[#32568]` describe. Locations 1 and 3 (draft exits, overlay two holders refused, one-holder CONTROL, sealed declined with one holder and two); location 2 (the five types); location 4 for `action` and `queue` in four states (not hydrated, after the read-side hydrator, bare-slot copy stamped `''`, stamped `sys_metadata`) × both registration orders, the one-holder flip, the bare-read CONTROL, and the overlay CONTROL. The `[#31699]` and `[#32407]` pins whose answers this moves are rewritten in place with the old answer named in the title.
- `protocol-boot-hydration-scoped.test.ts`, `protocol-registry-shadow.test.ts`: the legacy first-match graft pins now pin that a sealed type's package-less row is not registered over the package's item.
- `protocol.lookup-artifact-item-call-sites.test.ts`: the census rows for the hydrator's lookup and the new `declinedCopyReplaced` lookup.

## Acceptance notes

- Sweep of other exact-read exits: the active read, strict draft read, preview, layered read and its `draft` layer, and the scoped list's preview are judged here. The history, audit and diff doors (`/meta/:type/:name/history` and siblings) read the event ledger by `(type, name)` and serve no item at an exact address; they are not swept by this PR.
- Line budget: 12 files, +536 −60, under the ruling's ~1500, so location 4 ships here, not in a second PR.
- Row 11 moves a pin of seat ruling B (`packages/runtime/src/action-package-addressing.test.ts`, case 2): the route's answer on `lead` rode the defect this card closes. Measured on `origin/main`'s metadata-protocol source under this branch's test: `?package=alpha` answered the environment's item (`env`, on `lead`) and `?package=beta` its own (`beta`, on `contact`). The execution face reading the environment's own item (`_env`) stays its owner seat's follow-up, as ruling B records.
- First-party count: 0 (no composition here has two packages holding one name with a package-less row; the full dogfood battery is run on the final head and reported on the card).

## Verification

Measured on the merged tree (`origin/main` cbf6956fe + the branch), after a full `pnpm build` (exit 0):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`: 337 files passed, 7 skipped; 22763 tests passed, 36 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: 588 files passed; 12478 tests passed.
- `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main`: exit 0, `registered package-less-row-exact-address-by-type-class (new here)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/action-package-addressing.test.ts`: 59/59 at 55a9c1f24 (1 failed at c5a1b7e91 in CI `Test Core (3/8)`, the row 11 pin).
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0. `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 92 derived, each `exit 0` (six first answered exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET, and were re-run after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` and a fetch of the teardown self-test's pinned commit); `--ran`: 92 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
- Hydrator ablation (both hunks of `hydrateOverlayIntoRegistry` put back, marker proven in `dist/`): 9 failed / 202 passed across the three hydration suites; restored (blob == HEAD, marker absent from `dist/`): 211/211.
- The dogfood battery is reported on the card in the dev report for the final head.
